title: I-DARE deep data and prior model inventory

expected_deap_spec.why_it_matters: Original DEAP has 32 participants; project outputs may have more rows/subjects if merged or using derived pseudo-subject IDs, so inventory must separate DEAP raw from project-derived tables.
Representation learning should preserve trial identity and avoid stimulus leakage in cross-subject evaluation.

expected_deap_spec.expected: usually 40 trials x 40 channels x 8064 samples per subject file
expected_deap_spec.why_it_matters: 8064 samples at 128 Hz equals 63 seconds: 3 s baseline + 60 s stimulus.

expected_deap_spec.expected: 32 EEG channels in the 40-channel preprocessed array
expected_deap_spec.why_it_matters: Deep EEG models should use EEG channels separately from peripheral channels unless multimodal design is explicit.

expected_deap_spec.expected: 8 non-EEG peripheral channels in the 40-channel preprocessed array
expected_deap_spec.why_it_matters: EMG/EOG/GSR/resp/etc. should be handled as separate modalities, not silently mixed as EEG.
Current ROCA target focus is valence/arousal; dominance/liking can be auxiliary only if leakage-safe.

expected_deap_spec.expected: 3 s baseline = 384 samples; 60 s stimulus = 7680 samples at 128 Hz
expected_deap_spec.why_it_matters: Model inputs must document whether baseline is removed, concatenated, used as context, or excluded.

representation_requirements.must_have: Per-trial EEG/EMG time series aligned as subject_id, stimulus_id, trial_id, channel, time.
representation_requirements.failure_if_missing: If only engineered feature tables exist, this is not true representation learning.

representation_requirements.must_have: Explicit handling of 3 s baseline: subtract, encode as separate context, or drop.
representation_requirements.failure_if_missing: Baseline leakage or inconsistent residual target definition.

representation_requirements.must_have: Evaluation must keep subject out of training and compare against B2_LOCKED kernel_residual_shrink4 k=16.
representation_requirements.failure_if_missing: Model can look good while only rediscovering stimulus priors or subject leakage.

representation_requirements.must_have: First representation experiment should test arousal high-disagreement EEG, where fixed EEG-bandpower had confirmed residual signal.
representation_requirements.failure_if_missing: Deep model search becomes an unbounded architecture fishing exercise.

representation_requirements.must_have: Find prior proposed deep model scripts/logs/metrics and compare exact protocol, split, targets, and leakage controls.
representation_requirements.failure_if_missing: We may repeat the same failed deep-learning experiment without understanding why.

next_steps.title: Prior deep-learning run forensic review
next_steps.purpose: Open the candidate scripts/logs found by this inventory and extract model architecture, input tensor, split protocol, and exact metrics.
next_steps.success_condition: A short table says whether the old model failed because of input representation, split/generalization, target definition, or training instability.

next_steps.title: Minimal arousal high-disagreement EEG representation prototype
next_steps.purpose: Only after data readiness is confirmed, test a small GPU model on raw/time-frequency EEG for the one confirmed signal pocket.
next_steps.success_condition: Beats fixed EEG-bandpower high-disagreement residual model and does not degrade locked B2 evaluation.

next_steps.title: Subject-adaptive residual representation
next_steps.purpose: Learn EEG/EMG embeddings with k-shot subject context instead of linear correction on fixed features.
next_steps.success_condition: Beats B2 locked baseline or matches B2 with fewer calibration samples under paired subject-level gates.
